DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious reactive airway disease (acute bronchitis with post-tussive cough).

The clinical picture of a recent upper respiratory infection followed by nonproductive cough and exercise-induced shortness of breath, without current fever or sputum changes, strongly suggests airway hyperresponsiveness rather than active pneumonia or COPD. If symptoms persist beyond 8 weeks, we would reconsider asthma or consider a chest X-Ray to rule out structural abnormalities.
